values.help:
Which sound system plays audio.

- Auto: PipeWire if running, otherwise PulseAudio, otherwise ALSA.
- PipeWire / PulseAudio: through the sound server (passthrough via the HDMI sink's formats).
- ALSA: direct to the device; most reliable for TrueHD and DTS-HD MA.
- JACK: PCM only (up to 7.1); passthrough is not available.
